To avoid any possible conflicts and to improve the efficiency of SAR ADC2, ESP32-S3 provides an arbiter for SAR ADC2.
The arbiter supports fair arbitration and fixed priority arbitration.

A larger value indicates a higher priority.
The arbiter ensures that a higher priority controller can always start a conversion (sample) when required, regardless of whether a lower priority controller already has a conversion in progress.
If a higher priority controller starts a conversion whilst the ADC already has a conversion in progress from a lower priority controller, the conversion in progress will be interrupted (stopped).
The higher priority controller will then start its conversion.
A lower priority controller will not be able to start a conversion whilst the ADC has a conversion in progress from a higher priority controller.
Therefore, certain data flags are embedded into the output data value to indicate whether the conversion is valid or not.
